confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LiDAR Composite download GeoPackage spatial metadata index FAQ
verified_facts: EA states LiDAR Composite download ZIPs now include a GeoPackage spatial metadata index describing spatial location and temporal extent of raster elevation data.
semantic_limits: Index format migration does not itself prove a target-parcel match or elevation value.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: DSP metadata field semantics
verified_facts: DSP metadata includes use limitations, lineage, coordinate reference system, geographic extent, revision dates and service/download links.
DSP notes WMS/WFS service links are intended for GIS clients and may not work when opened directly in a browser.
semantic_limits: Metadata descriptions and service availability are provenance evidence, not parcel measurements.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 pre-requisites
verified_facts: OS states Terrain 5 is supplied as inert data in multiple formats and does not include software for manipulation.
semantic_limits: Ability to open or translate a file is not evidence of terrain accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 National Grid tile naming
verified_facts: OS Terrain 5 is supplied in 5km by 5km tiles identified from the National Grid reference of the south-west corner.
National Grid references encode grid-square location and quadrant.
semantic_limits: A matching tile reference is not proof that an exact parcel polygon intersects a particular raster cell or survey footprint.

candidates.name: OS Download Product Refresh Dates
verified_facts: OS lists Terrain 5 as quarterly in January, April, July and October and Terrain 50 as annual in July.
semantic_limits: Publication cadence is not acquisition date, survey date or parcel-specific currency.

candidates.name: Height and Imagery Portfolio Information
verified_facts: OS documentation groups Terrain products within its height and imagery portfolio and routes users to product-specific technical specifications.
semantic_limits: Portfolio classification is discovery context, not an independent terrain observation.

candidates.name: Plan requirements and surveying specification PG41s5 publication
verified_facts: HMLR identifies PG41 supplement 5 as technical guidance for plans lodged with HM Land Registry.
semantic_limits: Publication metadata alone is not parcel geometry evidence.

candidates.name: Developing estates plan requirements and surveying specification PG41s5
verified_facts: HMLR requires lodged plans to be based on an accurate survey and gives plottable-limit tolerances tied to plan scale.
The guide requires sufficient surrounding detail to relate development positions to registered title boundaries.
semantic_limits: PG41 plan tolerances apply to lodged development plans and are not terrain-height accuracy or ordinary title-plan general-boundary tolerance.

candidates.name: Index map official search PG10
verified_facts: HMLR PG10 was updated 20 July 2026 and describes official searches of the index map.
The 2026 update addresses mismatches between submitted shapefiles and search-of-index-map plans.
semantic_limits: Index-map search is registration/title discovery and does not provide an exact terrain polygon or height value.

candidates.name: Estate boundary approval PG41s1
verified_facts: HMLR describes estate boundary approval as comparing a developer's first site survey with the extent of the registered title so differences can be identified early.
semantic_limits: This service is development-registration context and does not establish the exact polygon for an unrelated target parcel.

candidates.name: Estate plan approval PG41s2
verified_facts: HMLR provides an estate plan approval service intended to simplify later searches and registrations on developing estates.
semantic_limits: Estate-plan approval is legal/registration workflow context, not a parcel DTM measurement or ordinary-title exact-boundary proof.
